name: La Fortuna · Arenal
tagline: Volcano views, hot springs and rainforest adventure
summary: La Fortuna sits below the perfect cone of Arenal Volcano. It's Costa Rica's adventure capital: hike old lava flows, cross hanging bridges in the canopy, swim below La Fortuna waterfall and soak in volcanic hot springs at night.
seasonNote: December to April is drier; the volcano is often cloud-wrapped in the green season, but mornings are clearer.
arrival: About 3 hours by shuttle from San José or Liberia airports.
gettingAround: Shuttles and tours; rent a car for flexibility.
cashTip: Cards work widely; US dollars are accepted in tourist areas but change comes in colones. Carry colones for sodas and buses.
foodTip: Casado plates, gallo pinto and fresh fruit batidos.
baseArea: La Fortuna town or the road toward Arenal
